name: StatInspector
description: Live attribute readout (mini-HUD) with a grouped settings picker for the stats you want on screen.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Your live character stats, at a glance.
Grouped stat picker — tick what you want on the mini-HUD.

fixed: Attribute icons now show correctly on Japanese and other non-English clients (they were falling back to a blank placeholder icon).
Attribute names now display in your client's language instead of English.
Percentage stats and the Base/Total (B/T) labels now read correctly and match the in-game attribute panel.
